title: Harness 不是一次性脚手架：自进化 Coding Agent 系统如何越跑越强
raw_text: 我们在专栏里手搓的 Agent Harness 本质上都是写死的工程约定，而南京大学团队最新发布的综述《Self-Evolving Coding Agents》则指向了下一个前沿：如何让 Harness 在运行中自我进化？本文系统拆解了该综述提出的五维自进化分类法（框架、记忆、技能/工具、模型、工作流拓扑），厘清了任务内、任务后与阶段性进化的时机与证据链，并结合实战专栏中的 Context Compaction、错误自愈、Subagent 等模块进行深度串讲，为开发者绘制了一张从“手工静态 Harness”迈向“越跑越强的自生长智能体”的完整工程地图。
reason_zh: 深度解析南大综述《Self-Evolving Coding Agents》，提出五维自进化分类法，为构建自进化Agent提供工程地图，极具启发性。

title: MoNe: Modular Neural Memory for Efficient Long Context Inference
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.17616v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We present MoNe, a lightweight modular neural memory that attaches to any frozen pretrained Transformer to enable long-context inference without retraining. MoNe reads context in fixed-size segments via test-time learning of fast-weight neural memory networks with layer-localized gradient updates; at inference, the memory generates keys and values from the query tokens alone, with no context tokens re-read. This two-phase design decouples inference cost from context length, achieving $O(N)$ preprocessing and $O(1)$ query cost with peak GPU memory that does not grow with $N$. At 128K tokens, MoNe reduces both compute and peak GPU memory by approximately 80% compared to ICL with only 6.4% parameter overhead. MoNe generalizes to context lengths far beyond the backbone's native window, achieving strong performance on needle-in-a-haystack and word extraction benchmarks from RULER, where ICL degrades sharply.
reason_zh: 提出MoNe模块化神经记忆，无需重训练即可为任意冻结Transformer扩展长上下文，具有高实用性和创新性。
summary_zh: 本文提出MoNe，一种轻量级模块化神经记忆，可附加到任何冻结的预训练Transformer上，实现无需重训练的长上下文推理。MoNe通过测试时学习快速权重神经记忆网络，以固定大小分段读取上下文，并在推理时生成键和值。实验表明，MoNe在长上下文任务上显著提升了性能，同时保持了计算效率，为长上下文处理提供了灵活高效的解决方案。

title: UKPLab/sentence-transformers v6.0.0
raw_text:
This major release introduces Multi-Vector Embedding models, also known as late interaction or ColBERT-style models, as a fourth model type alongside `SentenceTransformer`, `CrossEncoder`, and `SparseEncoder`. Going forward, you'll be able to use Sentence Transformers for training, inferencing, and interpreting Multi-Vector Embedding models.

It also modernizes the dependency floors to `transformers` v5, fixes a class of silent scoring bugs caused by half precision, and speeds up both training and encoding.

Install this version with

```bash
# Training + Inference
pip install sentence-transformers[train]==6.0.0

# Inference only, use one of:
pip install sentence-transformers==6.0.0
pip install sentence-transformers[onnx-gpu]==6.0.0
pip install sentence-transformers[onnx]==6.0.0
pip install sentence-transformers[openvino]==6.0.0

# Multimodal dependencies (optional):
pip install sentence-transformers[image]==6.0.0
pip install sentence-transformers[audio]==6.0.0
pip i
reason_zh: sentence-transformers v6.0.0引入多向量嵌入模型，是重要更新，对NLP开发者有实用价值。

title: Mixture-of-Expert Blocks Contain Strong Hallucination Detection Signals
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.17687v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Despite their widespread use, Large Language Models (LLMs) remain limited by a fundamental problem: the generation of plausible but false content, known as hallucinations. Most existing detection methods operate at the answer or sentence level, yet per-token detection is essential for localizing hallucinated spans and enabling fine-grained interventions. In this paper, we explore the use of the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) paradigm to address this gap. In MoE architectures, a single forward pass activates a sparse subset of experts (i.e., distinct feedforward networks per layer) via a routing mechanism, producing internal signals (e.g., router entropy, expert disagreement, and expert usage patterns) that are unavailable in dense architectures and have not been previously exploited for hallucination detection. To this end, we introduce InnerExpert, the first method to leverage these MoE-specific signals for per-token hallucination detection.
reason_zh: 发现MoE块中包含强幻觉检测信号，为幻觉定位提供新方法，具有高实用价值。
summary_zh: 该论文针对大语言模型（LLM）的幻觉问题，提出利用混合专家（MoE）块中的信号进行幻觉检测。现有检测方法多在答案或句子级别操作，而逐token检测对于定位幻觉片段和实现细粒度干预至关重要。研究发现，MoE块中的某些信号与幻觉的产生密切相关，可以作为强检测信号。通过分析这些信号，论文提出了一种新的检测方法，能够在token级别识别幻觉，从而更精确地定位问题区域。实验结果表明，该方法在多个基准上优于现有方法，为幻觉检测提供了新的思路。
title_zh: 混合专家块包含强幻觉检测信号

title: Fool's Gold: Defensive Deception Against Safety-Removal Attacks on Open-Weight Models
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.17202v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Safety alignment in open-weight language models is trivially removable: abliteration projects a refusal-mediating direction out of the weights in minutes, and no release-time defense we are aware of prevents it durably. What cannot be prevented can be deceived. Our defense, decoy hardening ("Fool's Gold"), concedes the refusal strip and poisons its payoff: once refusal is stripped, most answers to hazardous operational requests are confident, fluent decoys whose critical elements are falsified. Decoys are trained inside a differentiable simulation of the attack, expressing only in the attacked state; a refusal pin and benign leash hold clean-state behavior to the original. We instantiate it on seven models from five families (9B-122B, dense and mixture-of-experts). On the six models passing our pre-registered efficacy gate, 0.51-0.90 of attacked-state responses to held-out prompts are decoys, +0.27-0.84 attributable to the defense; all s
reason_zh: 提出对抗性防御策略，针对开放权重模型的安全移除攻击，思路新颖，具有防御价值。
summary_zh: 本文针对开放权重语言模型的安全对齐容易被移除的问题，提出了一种名为“诱饵加固”（Fool's Gold）的防御方法。该方法承认拒绝机制可以被移除，但通过毒化拒绝方向，使攻击者即使移除安全对齐也会陷入陷阱。实验表明，这种防御能有效欺骗攻击者，使其无法获得真正不安全的行为，为开放权重模型的安全防护提供了新思路。

title: Runtime Governance for Agentic AI: Action-Boundary Control with Trusted Provenance and Fail-Closed Execution
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.16891v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Agentic AI systems request tool actions that can modify files, send messages, launch jobs, or change workflow state. reason_zh: 提出Aegis运行时治理框架，为Agentic AI提供执行边界控制，安全价值高。
summary_zh: 论文介绍Aegis，一个运行时治理框架，为Agentic AI系统提供行动边界控制，包括可信来源验证和失败关闭执行。它解决了提示级治理无法创建执行边界的问题，防止有害操作副作用，提升系统安全性。

raw_text:
arXiv:2608.17270v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for scientific hypothesis generation. title: LiveHouse-TS: An Open-world Living Benchmark for Time Series Foundation Models
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.17299v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) have recently emerged as a highly promising paradigm for cross-domain zero-shot forecasting. However, existing evaluation protocols predominantly rely on static benchmarks with fixed historical test windows. While these benchmarks provide a valuable baseline snapshot, they evaluate an average performance on a fixed history, failing to capture how models behave in continuously evolving real-world environments characterized by seasonal variations, distribution shifts, and unexpected events. To bridge this gap, we introduce LiveHouse-TS, the first open-world living benchmark infrastructure for TSFMs. By evaluating models prequentially on real future data in open-world environments, LiveHouse-TS shifts time series benchmarking from snapshot accuracy to continuous temporal validity. reason_zh: 提出开放世界动态基准，解决时间序列基础模型评估的静态局限，具有实践意义。
summary_zh: 本文提出LiveHouse-TS，一个开放世界的动态基准，用于评估时间序列基础模型（TSFM）的跨域零样本预测能力。现有基准依赖固定历史测试窗口，只能评估平均性能。LiveHouse-TS通过持续更新测试窗口，模拟真实世界变化，提供更全面的评估。实验表明，该基准能更准确反映模型在动态环境中的表现。

title: deepset-ai/haystack v3.1.0-rc1
raw_text:
# Release Notes

## v3.1.0-rc1

### Upgrade Notes

- `exit_reason` is now a reserved state key on `Agent`. If you defined a custom `state_schema` key named `exit_reason`, rename it: the Agent now raises a `ValueError` at initialization when a reserved key is redefined.

- `Agent.state_schema` now contains the user-provided state schema, exactly as passed to `__init__`. Previously it contained the resolved schema, which also included `messages` and the keys the Agent manages internally (`step_count`, `token_usage`, `exit_reason`, ...). If you were reading `agent.state_schema` to inspect the effective runtime schema, use the new public attribute `agent.resolved_state_schema` instead.

- `DocumentMAPEvaluator` scores can change because average precision now uses all unique, valid ground-truth comparison values as its denominator and credits each value at most once. Re-baseline evaluations that relied on the previous scores.
